# Castor

> Zero-cloud-egress autonomous coding infrastructure. Castor runs AI coding agents in two wings: **Wing 1 (Cloud + Local Hybrid)** pairs your cloud lead architect with a local peer model (Qwen3.8-27B / Ternary-Bonsai) on your own GPU so file exploration, AST edits, and test loops run at $0.00 per token; **Wing 2 (100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped)** runs agents entirely on-prem with zero cloud API calls and zero code egress — inside a 5-layer sandbox with a per-task audit ledger.

## What It Does

- Registers as a stdio-only MCP server (exactly 3 tools: `castor_coworker`, `castor_task`, `castor_server`) — auto-installed for Claude Code and Antigravity via `npx -y mcp-castor install --client claude|antigravity|all`; Cursor, Codex, and any other stdio MCP client connect via standard MCP config.
- Offloads the high-volume tool-execution loop (read / edit / search / test) to a local engine — vLLM, llama.cpp, SGLang, Ollama, or LM Studio — via a loopback-only OpenAI-compatible SSE proxy (127.0.0.1:18022; engine 18020, status 18021).
- Contains every file path and shell command in a 5-layer zero-trust pipeline (root anchor → symlink containment → out-of-tree refusal → traversal normalization → binary sniff) plus a lexical shell scanner with dead-man fuse on all platforms, and Linux (5.13+) Landlock kernel confinement where available, and a 27-grammar Tree-Sitter AST syntax gate.
- Records a per-turn telemetry ledger (`castor stats`): tokens, KV cache hit, throughput, and cloud-counterfactual savings; per-task JSONL audit ledger for NIST 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 / ITAR / SCIF.

## Key Numbers (`castor stats`, 78-day ledger Sep 4 – Nov 21, 2026)

- 2.77B total tokens over 78 days (Sep 4 – Nov 21, 2026)
- 93.8% session KV-cache hit (2.53B of 2.71B prompt tokens reused from VRAM across multi-turn sessions, max_model_len 150,000)
- 49,414 autonomous turns · 1,187 sessions · 67,506 sandboxed tool calls (97.0% success)
- 70.4 tok/s sustained single-stream decode (n=1, 78-day mean)
- 260 tok/s aggregate decode across n=4 concurrent streams sharing a warm KV prefix
- 3,247 tok/s effective prefill (warm + cold)
- 14.15 s average TTFT (single-day vLLM /metrics snapshot, 2026-11-21)
- 137 sandbox test vectors: 123 blocked / 14 allowed
- $6,044.48 cloud counterfactual (Sonnet-tier $2/$10 per 1M tokens) vs $10.12 local electricity (56.2 kWh @ $0.18/kWh) = $6,034.36 reduction (99.83% of cloud cost)

## Cloud Lead Architect Models

- Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic): $4 in / $20 out per 1M
- Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic): $2 in / $10 out per 1M
- Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic): $0.10 / $0.50 per 1M (≤100K context); $0.50 / $2.50 above 100K
- GPT-6.2 Astra (OpenAI): $8 in / $40 out per 1M
- GPT-6.2 Sol (OpenAI): $2 in / $10 out per 1M
- Gemini 4 Argon (Google): $2 / $10 per 1M (Nov 2026 intro rate); $4 / $20 standard from Dec 1, 2026

## The Two Wings

- **Wing 1 · Cloud + Local Hybrid** — keep Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, or Codex as your frontier architect for the hard reasoning, while the high-volume file reads, code searches, AST edits, and test runs route to your local GPU at $0 per token.
- **Wing 2 · 100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped** — run coding agents entirely on your own GPU workstations or on-prem servers: zero cloud API calls, zero code egress, fully self-contained for regulated and offline environments.

## The Four Fronts

- **Open-Source Engine** — Castor Core, AGPL-3.0, free; stdio-only MCP over a zero-egress loopback boundary.
- **$1,500 48-Hour GPU & vLLM Setup Sprint** — turnkey dedicated-hardware stand-up: vLLM / KV-cache / MTP-DFlash2 tuning, sandbox hardening, benchmark + egress-audit handoff.
- **Custom Agent Workflow Plumbing** — agent orchestration, sandbox & shell-policy hardening, and team IDE rollout wired into the tool loop your agents already run.
- **Air-Gapped On-Prem Pilot** — fixed-scope 10–50 seat pilot (NIST 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 / ITAR) with commercial dual-license and a per-task audit ledger, over a fixed 1–3 month scope.

## Architecture

- 3 MCP tools over stdio (no network listener); tool surface compile-time gated: lean 8-tool core, +`ast` (ast_search / ast_replace), +`paper` (paper_lookup)
- DGI logit gate: model-classified `delta_z = logP(OVERLOADED) − logP(ADMIT)` dispatch classifier
- Token-budgeted lease semaphore: atomic `O_EXCL` file lease, 90% committed-token soft ceiling, KV-fill priority ranking
- 27 bundled Tree-Sitter grammars; in-memory parse gate before any write hits disk

## Air-Gapped Build

- `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features mcp,ast`: strips the `paper` research feature, retains the core stdio MCP surface + AST gate. Pair with a host-OS default-deny outbound firewall / air-gapped enclave networking for strict zero-egress enforcement.
- Ports: engine :18020, status :18021, SSE proxy :18022 — all bound to loopback (127.0.0.1).
- Sandbox: 5-layer path pipeline + lexical shell scanner on all platforms; Linux (5.13+) Landlock kernel confinement falls back to the lexical gates on unsupported filesystems.

## Licensing

AGPL-3.0 open source + commercial dual-license (opt-out) for air-gapped / enterprise deployments.
